description: Look up a well by 10-, 12-, or 14-digit API number using the core API's promoted lifecycle summaries. Returns operator, county, lifecycle dates, cumulative production and evidence; for a 14-digit API number it also includes exact monthly well-production history when available. Optional state disambiguates API numbers that occur across source contexts. Unpromoted or ambiguous records fail closed.

api_number.description: 10-, 12-, or 14-digit API well number; punctuation is allowed.

state.description: Optional state name/code used to disambiguate source records.

name: opa_lookup_well
title: Look Up Well by API Number
